scope: Exploratory first48 conditional reconstruction of the total processed-map ensemble mean in 42 signed-real E/B coordinates. Scientific design only; numerical execution and independent review pending.

identity.original_primary_T_and_fixed100: UNCHANGED; this is a distinct exploratory mean question, not a replacement rank analysis or reopened R36-07 attempt

selection.rule: Exact first48 by MC ID, frozen now after partial exposure. No substitutions, trimming, outlier removal, random ID selection, T-based selection, or data-dependent extension.
selection.exploratory_status: After-exposure design. Gaussian formulas have nominal model coverage for fixed sample; selective or confirmatory coverage of this adaptively timed research decision is not established.
selection.full100_relation: Original acquisition continues independently. Do not replace or update first48 result when more IDs arrive. A separately authorized full100 descriptive extension must retain first48 and disclose dependence.

basis.order: For X in E,B; ell in 2,3,4: real a_(ell,0), then for m=1..ell [sqrt(2)*Re a_(ell,m), -sqrt(2)*Im a_(ell,m)]. Total 2*(5+7+9)=42.
basis.reality: a_(ell,-m)=(-1)^m conjugate(a_(ell,m)); Im a_(ell,0)=0. Negative m used as a validation, not additional real degrees of freedom.
basis.identity: Squared Euclidean real-vector norm equals sum over all signed m of |E_lm|^2+|B_lm|^2.
basis.polarization_convention: COSMO; no U flip or frame change
basis.units: K_CMB; covariance K_CMB^2. Deterministic global 1e6 conversion allowed for microK_CMB numerical conditioning/display only.
basis.operator: Exactly existing lifted binary NS16 Lollipop mask then native NS2048 spin2 lmax4. No extra smoothing, deconvolution, covariance subtraction, beam cancellation assumption or response transfer.

estimand.definition: mu_C = E[Y | C] for the released Commander FULL005a processing law, represented by these 42 coefficients. C includes fixed simulated foreground realization, observed-estimated mixing matrices, release pipeline/instrument settings and the frozen extraction.
estimand.meaning: Total ensemble location, including fixed foreground residual, deterministic instrument/processing bias and nonlinear expectation shifts. It is not per-ID CMB truth, foreground-only residual, or physical nine-moment radius.
estimand.covariance: Sigma_C = Cov(Y | C) is total processed-map fluctuation covariance. It includes processed CMB, instrumental noise, random processing effects and all cross terms; consume once, no noise subtraction.

working_assumptions: Conditional on C, the 48 rows are independent and identically distributed N_42(mu_C,Sigma_C), with Sigma_C positive definite. This is a declared working model, not a theorem established by the release paper.
Fixed IDs represent draws from that law without outcome-based inclusion. The first48 timing and previous partial exposure are disclosed; no claim of selection-adjusted or preregistered coverage.

The native pipeline is nonlinear in calibration. Gaussian CMB/noise generation and fixed component mixing motivate but do not prove Gaussianity of these output coefficients. Gaussianity diagnostics cannot verify the assumption.
No source-matched beam or per-ID truth is needed to define the delivered-output ensemble mean. No inference from this mean to a pre-processing sky is authorized.

descriptive_no_gaussian_claim: sqrt(diag(S)/n) labelled estimated standard errors under iid finite variance, not finite-sample distribution-free confidence intervals
empirical coordinate quantiles labelled spread of rows, not uncertainty of the mean

model_confidence.coordinate_projections: ybar_j +/- sqrt(c*S_jj/n); simultaneous projections of E, not 42 marginal 95% intervals
model_confidence.euclidean_mean_norm_bounds: r=sqrt(c*lambda_max(S)/n); max(0,||ybar||-r) <= ||mu|| <= ||ybar||+r whenever mu in E. Conservative projected bound for total 42-coordinate mean only.
model_confidence.zero_mean_discriminator: T2=n*ybar^T S^{-1}ybar; F0=(n-p)*T2/[p*(n-1)]; report nominal Gaussian tail and zero-in-ellipsoid boolean as exploratory model contrasts, never foreground-detection p-values.
model_confidence.proof: sqrt(n)*(ybar-mu) is N(0,Sigma); (n-1)S is independent Wishart_p(Sigma,n-1); the normal/Wishart quadratic form gives (n-p)T2/[p(n-1)] ~ F_(p,n-p). Positive definite Sigma and n>p are required.
model_confidence.small_sample_warning: Only 6 denominator degrees of freedom; no asymptotic chi-square replacement or claim that narrow uncertainty is guaranteed.

optional_observed_contrast.default: Compute Mahalanobis D only if covariance admissible; predictive probability may be presented solely as nominal under the extra assumption below, not sourced calibration.
optional_observed_contrast.extra_assumption: Yobs is independent of these MC rows and has the identical N_42(mu_C,Sigma_C) law conditional on C. Because C includes W_hat(Dobs), release construction alone does not imply this conditional observation law.
optional_observed_contrast.F_predictive: n*(n-p)*D/[p*(n-1)*(n+1)] ~ F_(p,n-p) under the extra assumption
optional_observed_contrast.source_qualification: NOT_ESTABLISHED; preserve UNKNOWN exact observed/MC response and the fitted-mixing conditioning caveat
optional_observed_contrast.forbid: Do not claim exact unconditional, physical, or source-established observed p-value.

counterexample.model: Y=S_cmb+epsilon+f+b with E[S_cmb]=E[epsilon]=0, fixed f foreground and fixed b processing/instrument mean.
counterexample.witness: For any h in R^42, (f,b) and (f+h,b-h) produce the identical distribution of Y and the identical mu=f+b, Sigma and every statistic. Let h=t*v for unit v and t arbitrarily large: foreground norm is unbounded without an external bound on b, even when total mean is bounded.
counterexample.finite_anchor_extension: If an independently supplied set B bounds b, the foreground identified set is E minus B (Minkowski sum with -B). If ||b||<=beta is justified, ||f||<=||ybar||+r+beta at nominal coverage. beta is UNKNOWN here and must not be zero-filled. No such bound is claimed from this run.
counterexample.genuine_discriminator: The mean statistic can discriminate mu=0 from mu!=0 under the working law; it cannot discriminate foreground from processing attribution.

numeric_policy.arithmetic: float64; compute in microK_CMB if desired, serialize base K_CMB quantities and explicit scales
numeric_policy.source_integrity: Read only hash-bound JSONs; reject missing, duplicate, nonfinite, operator-inconsistent or reality-violating rows. No FITS or canonical input rewrite.
numeric_policy.rank_rule: Center Y. Compute all singular values. Full rank 42 requires sigma_min > 64*machine_epsilon*max(n,p)*sigma_max. If sigma_max=0, rank=0.
numeric_policy.solve: Use Cholesky and triangular solves; record all 42 eigenvalues, min/max, condition number, rank and normalized solve residual. No explicit inverse needed.
numeric_policy.quadratic_form_crosscheck: Compare Cholesky result with full-rank SVD solve: absolute difference <=1e-8*(1+abs(T2)); neither may truncate modes.
numeric_policy.singular_or_unstable: Retain descriptive mean/covariance; exact ellipsoid and model tails NOT_EVALUABLE. No pseudoinverse, shrinkage, diagonalization, ell cut, changed dimension, reduced subset, repeated trial or unrecorded repair to obtain a confidence claim.

controls_and_tests: Reality and norm-preserving real-basis conversion verified on every row and a complex signed-m fixture; m=0 has one real degree of freedom.
Row permutation invariance; global units factor 1e6 leaves T2/F0 and ellipse membership invariant within 1e-8 relative-plus-absolute tolerance; mean scales by 1e6 and S by 1e12.
Coordinate signed permutation or fixed orthogonal rotation preserves T2 and norm bounds; this is an algebraic basis control, not a sky rotation through a fixed mask.
Scalar p=1 formula reduces exactly to n*(mean-mu)^2/S=t_(n-1)^2=F_(1,n-1), and predictive formula includes 1+1/n. Include deliberate missing-n and ddof=n variants as failing witnesses.
Singular duplicated-coordinate fixture triggers abstention; no finite nominal confidence result returned by pseudoinverse.
Deterministic counterexample f=0,b=v versus f=v,b=0 with same Gaussian random array yields identical Y and all estimates. Scaling h demonstrates attribution unboundedness.

Use one seeded synthetic Gaussian coefficient-only batch (2000 replications, n=48,p=42) to check nominal 95% region coverage lies in [0.925,0.975]. Seed 200704997; one batch, retain failure, do not tune seed or formula. This tests implementation, not real-pipeline Gaussianity.
Report coordinate standardized skewness/kurtosis and leave-one-out changes in mean/covariance as descriptive sensitivity only. Never trim rows or certify Gaussianity from these diagnostics.
